def corner_and_objs(g):
    bg=g[0][0]
    d=defaultdict(list)
    for col,comp in objs(g,bg): d[col].append(comp)
    cands=[(col,comp) for col,comps in d.items() if len(comps)==1 for comp in comps]
    corner=max(cands,key=lambda x:len(x[1]))
    others=[(col,comp) for col,comps in d.items() for comp in comps if (col,comp)!=corner and (col,comp) not in cands or ((col,comp) in cands and (col,comp)!=corner)]
    others=[(col,comp) for col,comp in others if comp]
    return corner,others

def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; bg=g[0][0]
    d=defaultdict(list)
    for col,comp in objs(g,bg): d[col].append(comp)
    # corner: the single-object color with the largest object
    corner_col=max((col for col,comps in d.items() if len(comps)==1), key=lambda col: len(d[col][0]))
    tot={col:sum(len(c) for c in comps) for col,comps in d.items() if col!=corner_col}
    order=sorted(tot, key=lambda c:-tot[c])
    target_col=order[1]  # second-largest total
    comps=sorted(d[target_col], key=len)
    tgt=comps[len(comps)//2] if len(comps)%2 else comps[-(len(comps)//2+0)]  # odd: middle; even: larger-median
    for r,c in tgt: g[r][c]=corner_col
    return g
